notes: Added a real, independent background scheduler (HarvestScheduler, threading.Timer-based, same pattern as the existing EnrichmentScheduler for reference data) that re-syncs live Active IQ fleet data -- systems, risks, cases, TAM data, and every real configuration field -- on its own timer (default 4h), regardless of whether anyone has the app open. Previously only reference/ground-truth data (CVE feeds, version catalogs, firmware baselines) had a true background refresh; the actual customer harvest only ever ran as a side effect of an incoming browser request, so the tool could go stale indefinitely if left running unattended. New 'Auto-Refresh Fleet Data' card in Settings & Config with an enable/disable toggle, interval selector, live status, and manual 'Refresh Now' trigger.
